title: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Amendment) Bill
what_it_is: Building Maintenance and Strata Management (Amendment) Bill

sections.label: Increase in MCST numbers
sections.summary: The number of management corporation strata titles rose from 2,700 in 2005 to 3,400 today.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The number of management corporation strata titles (MCSTs) has also increased from 2,700 in 2005 to 3,400 today.

sections.label: BCA public consultations feedback
sections.summary: BCA held three public consultations, two focus group discussions and a town hall dialogue, receiving feedback from 1,700 respondents.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The Building and Construction Authority (BCA) held three rounds of public consultations, two focus group discussions and a town hall dialogue, where we received feedback from 1,700 respondents.

sections.label: Developers transferring deficit maintenance accounts
sections.summary: Clause 17 requires developers to transfer a positive balance of funds to MCST, after instances of deficit maintenance accounts.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Members may be surprised to know that there have been actual instances where developers transferred over maintenance accounts that were in deficit.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, under clause 17, we will require developers to transfer a positive balance of funds to MCST.

sections.label: Prohibiting concurrent council offices
sections.summary: Clauses 37 and 40 prohibit council members from holding more than one office concurrently, to address poor governance and conflicts of interest.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Such a situation can lead to poor governance, inadequate checks and balances, and possible conflicts of interest.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: So, clauses 37 and 40 explicitly prohibit council members from holding more than one of these offices concurrently.

sections.label: Commissioner placing MCST under management
sections.summary: Clause 53 empowers the Commissioner of Buildings to place an MCST under official management when management and operation fail.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: One measure in clause 53 will empower the Commissioner of Buildings to place an MCST under official management when there is a failure in the management and operation.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This new section 125A of the Bill stems from our experience with an actual case.

sections.label: Limits on proxy holding
sections.summary: Clause 59 limits the number of proxies one can hold and introduces directed proxy voting, capping a proxy holder at 2% of lots or two lots.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Clause 59, therefore, limits the number of proxies one can hold and to introduce directed proxy voting.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The First Schedule to BMSMA is amended to set a cap for any one proxy holder at either 2% of the total number of lots in a strata development or two lots, whichever is higher.

sections.label: Safety equipment installation allowed
sections.summary: Clause 26 amendment stops MCSTs from disallowing installations of safety equipment such as window or balcony grilles.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: With this amendment in clause 26, MCSTs can no longer disallow installations of safety equipment, such as grilles installed at windows or balconies.

sections.label: Common property definition expanded
sections.summary: Clauses 2(c) and (i) make shared building services and structural elements common property, with MCST responsible for maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For example, the Bill will make clear at clauses 2(c) and (i) that "common property" includes shared building services like fire sprinklers and central air-conditioning systems, as well as structural elements like beams and floor slabs, even if they are physically within one lot.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: External walls, roofs or facades of a building will also be made part of the common property, provided they are being used or enjoyed by occupiers of two or more lots.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The amendment will also make clear that the responsibility for maintenance and repair of such services and structural elements is on the MCST and not individual SPs, unless the individual SPs were responsible for the damage.

sections.label: Improving common property clarified
sections.summary: Clause 20 clarifies that improving common property includes replacing, removing or changing the use of facilities and structures.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: The amendment in clause 20 will clarify that improving the common property extends to replacement or removal of facilities and structures on common property or changing the use of common property.

sections.label: Right to safe living environment
sections.summary: The amendment gives strata-title property residents the right to a safe living environment.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Perhaps the most crucial amendment is that it gives strata-title property residents the right to a safe living environment.

sections.label: Limiting use of proxies
sections.summary: Limiting proxy use prevents one management committee person from collecting votes and influencing decisions for personal benefit.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Limiting the use of proxies is a good move to prevent any one person in the management committee from collecting votes and influencing decision-making to their own benefit.

sections.label: Three separate office holders
sections.summary: The change requires the posts of Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer to be held by three different persons.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In another condominium, I was told that there was one person who was the Chairman, Treasurer and Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: And with this change, the posts of Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer have to be held by three different persons.

sections.label: Criminal record declaration and Management Fund
sections.summary: A prospective appointee could be asked to declare any criminal record, and rental and charges from common property could go into the Management Fund.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One possibility is to ask a prospective appointee to make a declaration whether the person has a criminal record.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It is a fair move to allow rental and charges derived from common property to be placed into the MCST's Management Fund.

sections.label: Returning documents to MCST
sections.summary: Failing to return relevant documents to the MCST would be an offence, and a penalty for late return was asked about.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: After all, a $1 balance is still a positive balance.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am also pleased to note that it will officially be an offence to fail to return relevant documents to the MCST.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Without relevant past records and references, it would impact on the management abilities of the incumbent MCST.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I wish to ask if there should be a penalty for failure to return the documents within a stipulated period of time.

sections.label: Minimum requirements for as-built drawings
sections.summary: Residents wanted M&E as-built drawings but developers said they were not obliged to supply them, so minimum requirements should be listed.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Because residents wanted to have the mechanical and electrical (M&E) as-built drawings of their unit, but the developers said that they are not obliged to supply, which I am quite surprised to learn.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, it is good to list down what are the minimum requirements, such as as-built drawings, certificates of guarantees and so on.

sections.label: Standardising working days and calendar days
sections.summary: The speaker asked for standardisation in the use of either working days or calendar days, as the Act uses both.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Last but not least, I would like to ask for standardisation in the use of either "working days" or "calendar days" because, in the Act, there are "working days", and "calendar days".

sections.label: Limiting number of proxies held
sections.summary: One proposed amendment is to limit the number of proxies that one person can hold.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: First, one of the proposed amendments is to limit the number of proxies that one can hold.

sections.label: Quorum rule and challenging decisions
sections.summary: The speaker suggested raising the half hour rule minimum to 10% of share values or two subsidiary proprietors, and putting decisions on hold when the 30% quorum is not met.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: My first suggestion is that we raise the minimum number of people under the "half hour" rule to 10% of the share values of all lots or two subsidiary proprietors whichever is higher.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: My second suggestion is that all decisions made during a general meeting where the 30% quorum is not met are to be put on hold and condominium owners have the right to challenge the decisions.

sections.label: Conflict of interest declaration for SPs
sections.summary: SPs with conflicts of interest should declare them and not vote to appoint their own firms as service providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: At the minimum, there should be a declaration of potential conflict of interests and SPs who are conflicted should not be able to exercise their votes to appoint their own firms as service providers.

sections.label: Commissioner suspending management council
sections.summary: Clause 53 introduces sections 126A and 126B letting the Commissioner suspend an MC and place the MCST under official management.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Clause 53 of the Bill introduces new sections 126A and 126B which confer on the Commissioner new powers to suspend the management council (MC) of the MCST if it is satisfied that the MC is unable or refuses to carry out a duty under the Act that must be urgently carried out to remove any danger to the health or safety of the owners or occupants of the units and for such MCST to be placed under so-called "official management".

sections.label: Budget for activities and legal services
sections.summary: New section 38(3A) requires the MC to place budgets for activities and legal services for approval at the AGM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: A new section 38(3A) imposes upon the MC the need to have the budget for (1) the organising of any social, cultural, educational or sports activities that are for the benefit of all SPs and occupiers as well as (2) engagement of legal services for the MCST, to be placed for approval as part of an annual budget at the AGM.

sections.label: EOGM for unforeseen expenditure budget
sections.summary: Section 38(3B) proposes the MC may convene an EOGM to approve budgets for unforeseen or urgent expenditure for the same two items.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In section 38(3B), a further new amendment proposes that the MC may convene an extraordinary general meeting (EOGM) for approval of budget for unforeseen or urgent expenditure for the same two items.

sections.label: Kiasu budget and prudence concern
sections.summary: Requiring prior AGM budget approval may lead MCs to set aside a needlessly larger kiasu budget and may not encourage prudence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The new measure of requiring the budget to be approved beforehand at the previous AGM may also mean that MCs may resort to the practice of setting aside a kiasu budget which is needlessly larger than necessary and may not encourage prudence.

sections.label: Recourse, caveats and MC appointments
sections.summary: The passage asks about recourse against previous owners, caveats under section 37(4A), and the section 53(9A) exception for small MCSTs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: If the answer to my question is yes, would the owner be able to seek recourse against the previous owners and, if the position on this is unclear, would the Minister consider amending the legislation to allow the right of recourse at least in certain prescribed situations?

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Separately, if an action is being taken by the MC under section 37(4A) against an existing owner and such action has not come to an end, will the MC be entitled to file a caveat against the property in case the property is being put on the market?

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The new section 53(9A) prohibits a person from holding more than one appointment in the MC for the following appointments of Chairman, Treasurer and Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: While I can understand the rationale for this new rule, I would like to ask the Minister, would the proposed exception that the Minister has just mentioned in his speech be applied in the case of an MCST that is owned by a few owners, for example, just two or three owners?

sections.label: Number of MCSTs today
sections.summary: There are some 3,400 MCSTs today, described as a significant number.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: In fact, there are some 3,400 MCSTs today, a significant number, indeed.

sections.label: Developer maintenance fund balances
sections.summary: Requiring developers to hold sufficient balances to pay three to six months of estate maintenance and operations may be more appropriate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: This may affect the daily maintenance of the development project to the detriment of the residents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: It may be more appropriate to require the developer to ensure sufficient balances such that the monies can pay for at least three to six months of estate maintenance and operations.

sections.label: Mediation centre and management fund cap
sections.summary: A mediation centre with industry and legal specialists is hoped for, and a cap on management fund social and sports expenditure is suggested.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: From the quality of the finishings to differences between marketing brochures and the final products, many of these cases end up in Court.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I hope the Ministry or Commissioner of Buildings (COB) can set up a mediation centre with a panel of industry and legal specialists to look into these claims and provide economical and amicable solutions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Although the management fund can be used to fund and organise social and sports activities for residents in an estate, it would be prudent to put a cap on such expenditure since its main purpose is for the upkeep of the development project.

sections.label: Bill amendments and proxy votes
sections.summary: The Bill's amendments are long overdue and limit proxy votes, but how MCST resolutions are prevented from overriding a tightened proxy system is questioned.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Over the years, we have heard of stories related to disputes and legal suits filed because of non-consensual actions and misrepresentations within such developments.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Thus, the amendments in this Bill have been long overdue and would certainly provide greater clarity to the rules that can circumvent abuse or mismanagement by the representatives of MCSTs and preserve the rights of SPs.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: While the approach of limiting proxy votes is useful to prevent any individuals from garnering proportionately large numbers of proxy votes to influence decisions, how can we ensure that MCSTs do not pass resolutions that may override the benefits of a tightened proxy system?

sections.label: Approved maintenance charge in agreements
sections.summary: This clause requires developers to provide the approved maintenance charge in the Sale and Purchase Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: Under this clause, it requires developers to provide approved maintenance charge in the Sale and Purchase Agreement.

sections.label: MA quality and council office limits
sections.summary: The lack of professional MA companies is raised, and the Bill prohibits a council member from holding Treasurer with Chairperson or Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
sentences.text: From my discussion with different MCSTs, I understand the current pertinent issue is the lack of professional MA companies and the quality of the MAs that are available in the open market.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: First, the Bill seeks to prohibit a council member from holding the office of Treasurer concurrently with the offices of Chairperson or Secretary.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I hope the Ministry will take a step further and restrict the maximum number of consecutive terms to two terms any of these three positions which a council member can hold.

sections.label: Condominium council decision complaints
sections.summary: A member received feedback that some council members pushed through maintenance projects benefiting themselves and their allies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Second, I had received feedback from some condominium residents in my constituency about how certain council members would bulldoze certain decisions through meetings and gain approval for maintenance projects which benefit themselves and their allies.

sections.label: Accessible appeal processes for residents
sections.summary: Residents are deterred from making reasonable requests, so appeal processes should be accessible and inexpensive, especially for vulnerable elderly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: As a result, many residents are deterred from making perfectly reasonable requests.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: We should empower such residents, particularly the vulnerable elderly, by ensuring that such appeal processes be accessible and inexpensive.

sections.label: Fire safety composite panel cladding
sections.summary: 40 buildings, including private condominiums, may have used non-Class "0" composite panels not meeting the SCDF Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Next, I would like to touch on fire safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: It was recently reported that 40 buildings in Singapore, including private condominiums, could potentially have used non-Class "0" composite panels as cladding on their external walls, which do not meet the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Two of such condominiums reside within my constituency, and I understand that the cost of rectification is not insignificant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Moving forward, would the MCSTs be required to conduct a regular fire risk assessment of their buildings?

sections.label: Lift installation in old apartments
sections.summary: The member asks whether there are plans to help install or subsidise lifts in old private apartments, similar to the HDB programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Are there any plans to help install or at least subsidise installation of lifts in such old private apartments, similar to the Housing and Development Board's (HDB's) Lift Upgrading Programme?

sections.label: Section 18(1) maintenance charges amendment
sections.summary: The amendment requires developers to submit a maximum rate of maintenance charges pre-approved by the Commissioner.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The amendment to section 18(1) requires developers to give greater accountability as they are now required to submit a maximum rate of maintenance charges that is pre-approved by the Commissioner.

sections.label: Bill enhances BMSMA self-regulation
sections.summary: The Bill requires developers to obtain the Commissioner's approval on maintenance charge quantum before selling any unit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Bill enhances the self-regulating nature of BMSMA, enabling our citizens to better manage their estates, which can only be a step in the right direction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It now requires the developer to obtain approval from the Commissioner on the quantum of maintenance charges before the sale of any unit.

sections.label: Commissioner appointing managing agent
sections.summary: The Commissioner may appoint an OM to manage an estate when the MCST refuses or cannot perform a duty affecting health or safety, triggered by a written request from at least 20% of share value or 25% of subsidiary proprietors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This allows the Commissioner to appoint an OM to manage the estate in instances where there is a refusal or inability of the MCST to carry out a duty when there is a health or safety concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This is triggered by a written request comprising at least 20% of the aggregate share value of total lots or not less than 25% of the total number of SPs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Has this been considered in light of the notoriously poor attendance rate during AGMs as reported in the media, which currently requires a quorum of 30% of the aggregate share value of total lots pursuant to paragraph 3, First Schedule of the Act?

sections.label: Budget approval and Treasurer term limits
sections.summary: Only the general body at the AGM can allocate the overall annual budget, and the Treasurer has always been limited to two consecutive terms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: While a council can establish subcommittees to oversee projects, the allocation of the overall annual budget is a decision that only the general body can take at the AGM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For clarity, the Treasurer has always been limited to two consecutive terms, given the financial nature of the post.

sections.label: Reserved council seats for user groups
sections.summary: The new amendments reserve a seat so that each user group is represented in the council.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The new amendments reserve a seat so that each user group is represented in the council.

sections.label: Declaration of conflict of interest
sections.summary: A council member must declare the nature of his interest where there is a potential conflict of interest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Where there is a potential conflict of interest, a council member must declare the nature of his interest.

sections.label: Developers' maintenance budget estimates
sections.summary: The Commissioner will have a broad sense of comparable projects' charges, but developers must provide realistic estimates of the maintenance budget needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: While the Commissioner will have a broad sense of what comparable projects are charging, the onus is on developers to provide realistic estimates of the maintenance budget needed.

sections.label: Review of proposed maintenance charges
sections.summary: Developers must submit supporting documents such as quotations and consultants' estimates, and the Commissioner will review them and compare proposed maintenance charges with similar developments nearby.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Developers will also need to submit supporting documents like quotations from service providers and consultants' estimates to the Commissioner to substantiate their proposed rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Commissioner will review the documents and compare the proposed maintenance charges with those of developments of similar size and facilities in the same vicinity.

sections.label: Revising Charges Upwards
sections.summary: Developers may revise charges upwards if the charges are too low, subject to conditions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: If the charges are too low, developers have the flexibility of revising the rate upwards, but this comes with conditions.

sections.label: MCSTs Decide Common Funds Use
sections.summary: The proposal requires the general body to decide by ordinary resolution at the AGM whether to allow funds for such activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In keeping with the spirit of self-governance, we believe that MCSTs should decide how their common funds are used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Therefore, our proposal requires the general body to decide, as I said earlier, by way of passing an ordinary resolution at the AGM, if they wish to allow funds to be utilised for such activities.

sections.label: 20% Aggregate Share Value Threshold
sections.summary: The 20% aggregate share value threshold is pegged to the existing threshold criteria for SPs to ask for an EOGM.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: First, the 20% aggregate share value threshold is pegged to the existing threshold criteria for SPs to ask for an EOGM.

sections.label: Commissioner Appointing Order Manager
sections.summary: The Commissioner may appoint an OM if disputes have caused a lack of maintenance and threatened residents' health or safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Third, the Commissioner may decide to appoint an OM if he deems that the disputes have resulted in a lack of maintenance and threatened the health or safety of people living in the development.

sections.label: SPs Responsible Without Council
sections.summary: Where no one is willing to be nominated to form a council, SPs are collectively responsible for running the estate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In cases where no one is willing to be nominated to form a council, SPs will be collectively responsible for the running of the estate.

sections.label: Proposed Definition Covers Other Items
sections.summary: The proposed definition will cover items including balustrades, railings, fences, screens and lock or security mechanisms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The proposed definition will cover a host of other items, including balustrades, railings, fences, screens and lock or security mechanisms.

sections.label: MCST accessibility fund lift installations
sections.summary: There is no specific plan, but MCSTs can tap BCA's Accessibility Fund, which co-funds up to 80% with a $300,000 cap per development.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There is no specific plan to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But these types of MCSTs can tap on BCA's Accessibility Fund if they meet the eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Fund provides up to 80% co-funding for accessibility upgrading, which could include lift installations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But there is an overall funding cap of $300,000 per development.

sections.label: Interim MAs and defects rectification
sections.summary: Extending the DLP alone will not fix poor quality; MND is looking at giving home buyers more information on developers' and contractors' track records.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The concern here seems to be with interim MAs being ineffective in helping SPs pursue defects rectification with developers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But extending the DLP on its own will not address the root problem of poor quality by some developers and contractors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: This is something that MND is looking into.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Specifically, we are looking at providing home buyers with more information about the track record of developers and contractors with regard to design and construction quality.

sections.label: Statutory presumption and lateral seepage
sections.summary: The statutory presumption clause placing responsibility for inter-floor leakage on the unit owner above does not apply to lateral seepage cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: To begin with, the statutory presumption clause, which assumes that the responsibility for inter-floor leakage is with the owner of the unit above, does not apply to cases of lateral seepage.
